subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Exonerate
solution: The correct answer is '**Engage**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Exonerate**' is '**Engage**'. • **Exonerate**: to say officially that somebody was not responsible for something bad that happened. (आधिकारिक रूप से दोषमुक्त घोषित करना) • *Example: Lyndon was **exonerated** from the accusation of cheating.* • **Engage**: to interest or attract somebody. [(किसी को) आकृष्‍ट करना या (काम में) लगाना] • *Example: You need to **engage** the students’ attention right from the start.* **Correct Answer:__** *Engage.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Exempt**: free from having to do something or pay for something. (किसी बाध्यता से मुक्त) • **Absolve**: to say formally that somebody does not have to take responsibility for something. (अपराध, पाप, उत्तरदायित्‍व आदि से मुक्त करना; दोषमुक्त करना, निरपराध ठहरना) • **Acquit**: to state formally that a person is not guilty of a crime. (किसी के निर्दोष होने की विधिवत घोषणा करना) OR free (someone) from a criminal charge by a verdict of not guilty. 177:Tcaa, The correct answer is '**Graffiti**'.
